item.title: BJP-Led Mahayuti Sweeps Maharashtra Local Body Polls, Opposition Raises Allegations
item.description: The BJP-led Mahayuti alliance recorded a resounding victory in Maharashtra’s local body elections, winning most municipal posts, while the Opposition accepted defeat but questioned the fairness of the electoral process.

item.title: Water released into BTP canals to support rabi crops
item.description: Rayadurg: To meet the irrigation requirements of farmers under the Bhairavani Tippa Project (BTP), water was released into the right and left canals on Sunday following special prayers at the BTP reservoir.The release was carried out in the presence of Government Whip and Rayadurg MLA Kalava Srinivasulu. item.description: Realme confirms January 6 India launch for the 16 Pro series, bringing Android 16, new cameras, and premium design upgrades.

item.title: PM Modi’s Claim On Assam And East Pakistan: What The 1946 Cabinet Mission Plan Reveals
item.description: PM Modi has said the Congress nearly allowed Assam to become part of East Pakistan in 1946. This article explains the Cabinet Mission Plan, Assam’s resistance, and the roles played by Gopinath Bordoloi, Mahatma Gandhi, and Jawaharlal Nehru.

item.title: Bhuvaneswari inaugurates mega health camp
item.description: Rampachodavaram (ASR District): Nara Bhuvaneswari, Managing Trustee of the NTR Memorial Trust, stated that the organisation has been dedicated to serving the poor in the Telugu states for nearly three decades. item.title: Gadde Veeranki appointed TDP NTR and Krishna dist chiefs
item.description: Vijayawada: Telugu Desam Party (TDP) National President and Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu appointed Gadde Anuradha, wife of Vijayawada East MLA Gadde Rammohan Rao, as the TDP president of NTR district. This historic appointment makes her the first woman to head a TDP district unit in the region formerly known as Krishna district.
